body: Aravind Viswanathan (CFO) on 2025-07-25 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "For FY26, we expect to be at ~2X industry growth, on the back of our Q1 performance and steady conversion of TCV to revenue" Metric: FY26 CC revenue growth vs industry. Target: ~2x industry. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: FY26 CC growth 6.7% ('For the full year, revenues grew 6.7% in constant currency terms'); company: 'delivering more than 2x industry growth' (Q4FY26). 'Industry' is the company's own benchmark (large-cap peers ~2-3% CC) - single-source.
